THE GOLD COAST HAS BECOME INDEPENDENT AS GHANA, THE FIRST AFRICAN COLONY TO TAKE ITS PLACE AS A FREE NATION IN THE COMMONWEALTH.
BRITAIN HAS EXPLODED ITS FIRST HYDROGEN BOMB IN TESTS OVER MALDEN ISLAND IN THE PACIFIC.
THE FEDERATION OF MALAYA HAS GAINED ITS INDEPENDENCE WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH. CROWDS IN KUALA LUMPUR CRIED 'MERDEKA!'
A FIRE IN THE WINDSCALE ATOMIC PILE IN CUMBERLAND HAS RELEASED RADIOACTIVITY. MILK FROM NEARBY FARMS IS BEING POURED AWAY.
SIR EDMUND HILLARY AND HIS NEW ZEALAND PARTY HAVE REACHED THE SOUTH POLE BY FARM TRACTOR, THE FIRST TO GO OVERLAND SINCE CAPTAIN SCOTT.
EIGHT MANCHESTER UNITED PLAYERS ARE AMONG THE DEAD AFTER THEIR AIRLINER CRASHED ON TAKE-OFF IN THE SNOW AT MUNICH.
THE CAMPAIGN FOR NUCLEAR DISARMAMENT HAS MARCHED OVER EASTER FROM LONDON TO THE WEAPONS ESTABLISHMENT AT ALDERMASTON.
RACIAL DISTURBANCES HAVE BROKEN OUT IN NOTTING HILL IN WEST LONDON. POLICE HAVE MADE MORE THAN A HUNDRED ARRESTS.
BRITAIN'S FIRST STRETCH OF MOTORWAY, THE PRESTON BY-PASS, HAS BEEN OPENED BY THE PRIME MINISTER.
THE DALAI LAMA HAS FLED TIBET ACROSS THE HIMALAYAS AND HAS BEEN GRANTED ASYLUM IN INDIA.
THE QUEEN AND PRESIDENT EISENHOWER HAVE OPENED THE ST LAWRENCE SEAWAY, LINKING THE GREAT LAKES OF CANADA TO THE ATLANTIC.
THE HOVERCRAFT SR.N1 HAS CROSSED THE ENGLISH CHANNEL ON A CUSHION OF AIR, FIFTY YEARS AFTER BLERIOT FLEW IT.
THE BRITISH MOTOR CORPORATION HAS LAUNCHED A SMALL NEW CAR, THE MINI. IT SELLS FOR LESS THAN FIVE HUNDRED POUNDS.
MR MACMILLAN HAS LED THE CONSERVATIVES TO A THIRD GENERAL ELECTION VICTORY IN A ROW, WITH AN INCREASED MAJORITY.
MR MACMILLAN HAS TOLD THE SOUTH AFRICAN PARLIAMENT IN CAPE TOWN THAT A WIND OF CHANGE IS BLOWING THROUGH THE CONTINENT.
POLICE HAVE OPENED FIRE ON DEMONSTRATORS AT SHARPEVILLE IN SOUTH AFRICA. SIXTY-NINE PEOPLE ARE DEAD.
THE GOVERNMENT HAS CANCELLED BLUE STREAK AS A MILITARY MISSILE. THE MINISTER OF DEFENCE SAYS IT MAY YET HAVE A FUTURE AS A SPACE LAUNCHER.
NIGERIA, AFRICA'S MOST POPULOUS NATION, HAS BECOME INDEPENDENT WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH.
PENGUIN BOOKS HAS BEEN FOUND NOT GUILTY OF OBSCENITY FOR PUBLISHING 'LADY CHATTERLEY'S LOVER'. THE BOOK IS SELLING OUT.
THE JAGUAR E-TYPE HAS BEEN UNVEILED AT THE GENEVA MOTOR SHOW. MR ENZO FERRARI IS SAID TO HAVE CALLED IT THE MOST BEAUTIFUL CAR EVER MADE.
SOUTH AFRICA HAS LEFT THE COMMONWEALTH AND DECLARED ITSELF A REPUBLIC.
BRITAIN HAS APPLIED TO JOIN THE EUROPEAN ECONOMIC COMMUNITY.
THE CONTRACEPTIVE PILL HAS BECOME AVAILABLE ON THE NATIONAL HEALTH SERVICE.
TANGANYIKA HAS BECOME INDEPENDENT WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH.
THE NEW COVENTRY CATHEDRAL HAS BEEN CONSECRATED BESIDE THE RUINS OF THE OLD ONE, DESTROYED IN THE BLITZ.
IN WHAT THE PRESS IS CALLING THE NIGHT OF THE LONG KNIVES, MR MACMILLAN HAS SACKED A THIRD OF HIS CABINET.
THE TELSTAR SATELLITE HAS RELAYED THE FIRST LIVE TELEVISION PICTURES ACROSS THE ATLANTIC TO GOONHILLY DOWNS IN CORNWALL.
JAMAICA AND TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO HAVE BECOME INDEPENDENT WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH.
THE PRIME MINISTER HAS GIVEN BRITAIN'S SUPPORT TO PRESIDENT KENNEDY OVER THE SOVIET MISSILES IN CUBA. THE WORLD HOLDS ITS BREATH.
BRITAIN IS GRIPPED BY THE COLDEST WINTER IN MORE THAN TWO HUNDRED YEARS. THE SEA HAS FROZEN AT HERNE BAY.
PRESIDENT DE GAULLE OF FRANCE HAS VETOED BRITAIN'S APPLICATION TO JOIN THE COMMON MARKET.
THE WAR MINISTER, JOHN PROFUMO, HAS RESIGNED, ADMITTING THAT HE LIED TO THE HOUSE OF COMMONS.
A GANG HAS HELD UP THE GLASGOW TO LONDON MAIL TRAIN IN BUCKINGHAMSHIRE AND ESCAPED WITH MORE THAN TWO AND A HALF MILLION POUNDS.
MR MACMILLAN HAS RESIGNED THROUGH ILL HEALTH. SIR ALEC DOUGLAS-HOME IS THE NEW PRIME MINISTER.
THE BEATLES HAVE ARRIVED IN NEW YORK TO A FRENZIED WELCOME. AMERICA APPEARS TO HAVE SURRENDERED.
A PIRATE STATION, RADIO CAROLINE, HAS BEGUN BROADCASTING POP MUSIC FROM A SHIP OFF THE ESSEX COAST.
INDIA MOURNS PANDIT NEHRU, ITS FIRST PRIME MINISTER, WHO HAS DIED IN NEW DELHI.
DONALD CAMPBELL HAS SET A WORLD LAND SPEED RECORD OF 403 MPH IN BLUEBIRD ON LAKE EYRE IN SOUTH AUSTRALIA.
LABOUR HAS NARROWLY WON THE GENERAL ELECTION. HAROLD WILSON IS THE NEW PRIME MINISTER.
SIR WINSTON CHURCHILL HAS DIED AT THE AGE OF NINETY. HE IS TO BE GIVEN A STATE FUNERAL.
CANADA HAS RAISED ITS NEW MAPLE LEAF FLAG FOR THE FIRST TIME ON PARLIAMENT HILL IN OTTAWA.
AUSTRALIA IS TO SEND A BATTALION OF INFANTRY TO SOUTH VIETNAM.
WAR HAS BROKEN OUT BETWEEN INDIA AND PAKISTAN OVER KASHMIR.
IAN SMITH HAS DECLARED RHODESIA INDEPENDENT OF BRITAIN. MR WILSON CALLS IT AN ACT OF REBELLION.
INDIRA GANDHI HAS BECOME PRIME MINISTER OF INDIA.
AUSTRALIA HAS CHANGED TO DECIMAL CURRENCY. THE POUND HAS GIVEN WAY TO THE DOLLAR.
MR WILSON HAS WON THE GENERAL ELECTION WITH A MAJORITY OF NINETY-SIX.
ENGLAND HAVE WON THE WORLD CUP, BEATING WEST GERMANY FOUR GOALS TO TWO AFTER EXTRA TIME AT WEMBLEY.
A COLLIERY SPOIL TIP HAS SLID ONTO A SCHOOL AT ABERFAN IN SOUTH WALES. 144 ARE DEAD, 116 OF THEM CHILDREN.
THE TANKER TORREY CANYON HAS RUN AGROUND OFF CORNWALL. THE RAF HAS BOMBED THE WRECK TO BURN OFF THE OIL.
AUSTRALIANS HAVE VOTED OVERWHELMINGLY IN A REFERENDUM TO COUNT ABORIGINAL PEOPLE IN THE NATIONAL CENSUS.
FRANCIS CHICHESTER HAS SAILED INTO PLYMOUTH AFTER A SINGLE-HANDED VOYAGE AROUND THE WORLD. HE IS TO BE KNIGHTED.
THE POUND HAS BEEN DEVALUED FROM $2.80 TO $2.40. MR WILSON INSISTS THAT THE POUND IN YOUR POCKET HAS NOT BEEN DEVALUED.
THE AUSTRALIAN PRIME MINISTER, HAROLD HOLT, HAS DISAPPEARED WHILE SWIMMING OFF CHEVIOT BEACH IN VICTORIA.
THE GOVERNMENT HAS ANNOUNCED THAT BRITISH FORCES WILL BE WITHDRAWN FROM EAST OF SUEZ BY 1971.
MAURITIUS HAS BECOME INDEPENDENT WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH.
PIERRE TRUDEAU HAS BECOME PRIME MINISTER OF CANADA.
SURGEONS AT THE NATIONAL HEART HOSPITAL IN LONDON HAVE PERFORMED BRITAIN'S FIRST HEART TRANSPLANT.
AN EARTHQUAKE AT MECKERING IN WESTERN AUSTRALIA HAS SPLIT ROADS, BUCKLED RAILWAY LINES AND LEVELLED THE TOWN.
THE BRITISH CONCORDE HAS MADE ITS MAIDEN FLIGHT FROM FILTON, NEAR BRISTOL.
ROBIN KNOX-JOHNSTON HAS BECOME THE FIRST MAN TO SAIL SINGLE-HANDED AND NON-STOP AROUND THE WORLD.
BRITISH TROOPS HAVE BEEN SENT ONTO THE STREETS OF LONDONDERRY AND BELFAST.
ROD LAVER OF AUSTRALIA HAS WON THE TENNIS GRAND SLAM FOR THE SECOND TIME.
THE HOUSE OF COMMONS HAS VOTED TO ABOLISH THE DEATH PENALTY FOR MURDER PERMANENTLY.
THE AGE OF MAJORITY IN BRITAIN HAS BEEN LOWERED FROM TWENTY-ONE TO EIGHTEEN.
THE QUEEN HAS VISITED AUSTRALIA TO MARK THE BICENTENARY OF CAPTAIN COOK'S LANDING AT BOTANY BAY.
EDWARD HEATH HAS LED THE CONSERVATIVES TO A SURPRISE VICTORY IN THE GENERAL ELECTION.
FIJI HAS BECOME INDEPENDENT WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH.
A CYCLONE AND TIDAL WAVE HAVE KILLED HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS IN EAST PAKISTAN.
ROLLS-ROYCE HAS GONE BANKRUPT OVER THE COST OF THE RB211 ENGINE. THE GOVERNMENT IS TO NATIONALISE THE COMPANY.
BRITAIN HAS CHANGED TO DECIMAL CURRENCY. THE SHILLING IS NO MORE.
EAST PAKISTAN HAS DECLARED ITS INDEPENDENCE AS BANGLADESH.
THE HOUSE OF COMMONS HAS VOTED IN FAVOUR OF JOINING THE COMMON MARKET.
INDIA AND PAKISTAN ARE AT WAR AGAIN. INDIAN TROOPS HAVE ENTERED DACCA.
THIRTEEN CIVIL RIGHTS MARCHERS HAVE BEEN SHOT DEAD BY SOLDIERS IN LONDONDERRY.
THE MINERS' STRIKE HAS BROUGHT POWER CUTS ACROSS BRITAIN AND A STATE OF EMERGENCY.
CEYLON HAS BECOME A REPUBLIC AND TAKEN THE NAME SRI LANKA.
PRESIDENT AMIN HAS EXPELLED UGANDA'S ASIANS. THOUSANDS ARE ARRIVING IN BRITAIN WITH LITTLE MORE THAN A SUITCASE.
GOUGH WHITLAM HAS LED LABOR TO VICTORY IN AUSTRALIA AFTER TWENTY-THREE YEARS IN OPPOSITION.
BRITAIN, IRELAND AND DENMARK HAVE JOINED THE EUROPEAN ECONOMIC COMMUNITY.
THE BAHAMAS HAS BECOME INDEPENDENT WITHIN THE COMMONWEALTH.
THE QUEEN HAS OPENED THE SYDNEY OPERA HOUSE, FOURTEEN YEARS AND SEVERAL BUDGETS AFTER WORK BEGAN.
PRINCESS ANNE HAS MARRIED CAPTAIN MARK PHILLIPS AT WESTMINSTER ABBEY.
TO SAVE FUEL DURING THE MINERS' DISPUTE, THE GOVERNMENT HAS ORDERED A THREE-DAY WORKING WEEK FROM THE NEW YEAR.
BRISBANE HAS BEEN DEVASTATED BY ITS WORST FLOODS OF THE CENTURY.
THE GENERAL ELECTION HAS PRODUCED A HUNG PARLIAMENT. MR WILSON RETURNS TO DOWNING STREET.
INDIA HAS EXPLODED A NUCLEAR DEVICE IN THE RAJASTHAN DESERT.
IRA BOMBS IN TWO BIRMINGHAM PUBLIC HOUSES HAVE KILLED TWENTY-ONE PEOPLE.
CYCLONE TRACY HAS DESTROYED MOST OF DARWIN ON CHRISTMAS DAY.
MARGARET THATCHER HAS BEEN ELECTED LEADER OF THE CONSERVATIVE PARTY, THE FIRST WOMAN TO LEAD A MAJOR BRITISH PARTY.
BRITAIN HAS VOTED BY TWO TO ONE IN A REFERENDUM TO STAY IN THE COMMON MARKET.
THE WEST INDIES HAVE WON THE FIRST CRICKET WORLD CUP, BEATING AUSTRALIA AT LORD'S.
THE QUEEN HAS OPENED THE FORTIES PIPELINE, BRINGING NORTH SEA OIL ASHORE IN SCOTLAND.
THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL HAS DISMISSED GOUGH WHITLAM'S GOVERNMENT. MALCOLM FRASER IS CARETAKER PRIME MINISTER OF AUSTRALIA.
CONCORDE HAS ENTERED SCHEDULED SERVICE WITH BRITISH AIRWAYS, FLYING FROM LONDON TO BAHRAIN.
MR WILSON HAS UNEXPECTEDLY RESIGNED. JAMES CALLAGHAN IS THE NEW PRIME MINISTER.
THE OLYMPIC GAMES HAVE OPENED IN MONTREAL. MANY AFRICAN NATIONS ARE STAYING AWAY IN PROTEST.
A HEATWAVE AND DROUGHT GRIP BRITAIN. A MINISTER FOR DROUGHT HAS BEEN APPOINTED, AND IT HAS PROMPTLY RAINED.
THE CHANCELLOR HAS ASKED THE INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND FOR A LOAN OF 3.9 BILLION DOLLARS.
A COMMUTER TRAIN HAS DERAILED AND BROUGHT DOWN A ROAD BRIDGE AT GRANVILLE IN SYDNEY. EIGHTY-THREE ARE DEAD.
AUSTRALIA HAVE WON THE CENTENARY TEST AGAINST ENGLAND IN MELBOURNE BY 45 RUNS, THE SAME MARGIN AS IN 1877.
STREET PARTIES ACROSS BRITAIN AND THE COMMONWEALTH HAVE MARKED THE QUEEN'S SILVER JUBILEE.
VIRGINIA WADE HAS WON THE WIMBLEDON LADIES' SINGLES TITLE IN THE QUEEN'S JUBILEE YEAR.
FREDDIE LAKER'S SKYTRAIN HAS BEGUN CUT-PRICE FLIGHTS FROM GATWICK TO NEW YORK.
